notes.title: Patch for Linux
notes.notes: The [b]Linux[/b] builds for all four chapters of Snail Trek have been patched to address the " SHIFT to move fast" bug (the bug was: pressing shift, or alt, or a few other special keys would instead result in the parser box opening up with a number in it).

notes.title: Snail Trek series now available for MacOS and Linux!
notes.notes: I'm happy to announce that Snail Trek 1-4 are now available for MacOS and Linux! Enjoy!
